scope: WSL software GLES2, Proving Grounds split screen, 512-slot queue and two virtual controller inputs.
method: Verified every maximum inside the measured 30-second race window was positive and no larger than total execution time in that interval. Clean recorder end and no dropped frame records.
limitations: The private replay reused an older test input driver object with recording mode engaged throughout. The normal desktop app was rebuilt from the current source separately. A concurrent local build can affect timings. Host timing can include driver and swap waiting and is not a direct measurement of GPU time or input latency.
